leo: FYI CI started failing after we bumped redwood-inference-js to 1.6.0. Jest jobs error out with require/import mismatches. Local macOS node 18 seems fine.
nora: paste the CI log?

leo: ```
Error [ERR_REQUIRE_ESM]: Must use import to load ES Module: /workspace/node_modules/redwood-inference-js/dist/index.mjs
    at Object.Module._extensions..js (internal/modules/cjs/loader.js:...)
    at Module.load (internal/modules/cjs/loader.js:...)
    at Function.Module._load (internal/modules/cjs/loader.js:...)
    at Module.require (internal/modules/cjs/loader.js:...)
    at require (internal/modules/cjs/helpers.js:...)
```

kevin: that screams "package publishes only ESM". Can you show redwood-inference-js/package.json?

leo: snippet I grabbed from node_modules: ```json
{"name":"redwood-inference-js","version":"1.6.0","type":"module","exports":{"import":"./dist/index.mjs","types":"./dist/index.d.ts"}}
```

nora: no "require" field -> CJS consumers (jest with CJS runners, older ts-jest setups) will try require() and blow up.

kevin: short-term options: 1) force test runners to treat the package as ESM 2) add mocks that don't require the real package 3) ask SDK to publish a CJS/dual bundle.

leo: we tried vi.mock and jest.mock; both fail in different ways. Vitest with deps.inline gets past import, but mocking returns native module shape which makes tests brittle. Example: `vi.mock('redwood-inference-js', () => ({ generate: vi.fn(() => 'x') }))` still pulls the real default in some tests.

nora: common pitfalls: - package has "type":"module" and only mjs entrypoints - exports map only has "import" - d.ts uses `export default` vs `export =` causing TS interop confusion - CI uses older node runner image with different module resolution.

kevin: for vitest try: `test: { deps: { inline: ['redwood-inference-js'] }, environment: 'node' }` and ensure `transformMode: { web: [/\.m?js$/] }` if using edge-like transforms. But that doesn't solve jest.

leo: for jest we ended up with a working-ish workaround: use esbuild-jest to transform node_modules for the package: ```js
// jest.config.js
module.exports = {
  transform: {
    '^.+\\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|mjs)$': 'esbuild-jest'
  },
  transformIgnorePatterns: ['/node_modules/(?!(redwood-inference-js)/)']
}
```

nora: alternative for jest: add a manual mock under `__mocks__/redwood-inference-js.cjs.js` and map the package to that mock with `moduleNameMapper`. Example: `moduleNameMapper: {'^redwood-inference-js$': '<rootDir>/__mocks__/redwood-inference-js.cjs.js'}`. But that requires keeping mock API in sync.

kevin: another neat trick: use `jest.unstable_mockModule` (node ESM support) + native ESM runner in node 18+ but CI pipelines often aren't configured for that yet.

leo: types issue cropped up too: TypeScript complained `Module '"redwood-inference-js"' has no default export` in some files. We had to flip `compilerOptions.esModuleInterop` and `allowSyntheticDefaultImports` to reduce friction. Not ideal to change project-wide flags.

pkg-bot: Created issue redwood-inference-js#234: "Publish CJS build and add testing notes" (https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-inference-js/issues/234).

ci-bot: Pipeline 4773 — failing jest job snapshot, rerun requested.

nora: long-term best fix: SDK publishes dual packages and adds exports map with "import" and "require". Example: `"exports": {"import":"./dist/esm/index.mjs","require":"./dist/cjs/index.cjs","types":"./dist/index.d.ts"}`. Also include a `main` pointing at CJS for old tooling. 

kevin: +1. SDK should also publish a short "testing" section in README with recommended jest/vitest snippets and mock patterns, and add a tiny cjs fixture for folks who need to mock easily.

leo: I pushed a minimal repro at tools/test-repros/redwood-esm-cjs-mock showing jest + vitest failures and the esbuild-jest workaround. Link: repo/internal/tools/test-repros/redwood-esm-cjs-mock (private).

nora: action items: - open internal devx wiki page with snippets (I'll do) - ask SDK to publish dual bundle and docs (pkg-bot did issue) - add CI smoke test that runs on ubuntu-lts to catch regressions (leo)

leo: temporary CI fix applied to our repo: added esbuild-jest transform and a small manual mock for heavy mocking tests. Hoping to revert after SDK release.

kevin: note for maintainers: when publishing a dual bundle, also ensure `types` are identical for both entries and avoid `export =` in d.ts unless you provide `@types` compatibility. Add a small example `jest.config.js` and `vitest.config.ts` to the package repo.

leo: thanks all. ping me if you want to try the repro locally. Will update when the upstream package cuts a CJS build. :pray:
